slices.description: Convert Flask routes to FastAPI endpoints with equivalent functionality
Replace Flask request handling with FastAPI dependency injection and request models
Convert Flask response formatting to FastAPI's automatic JSON serialization
Refactor Flask blueprints into FastAPI router structure
Replace Flask configuration management with FastAPI dependency injection
Convert Flask database integration to FastAPI async patterns
Replace Flask authentication with FastAPI security patterns
